question: What accomplishment is achieved for the one born of the own family lotus?
premises: An action is done by this alone
The beneficiary is born of the own family lotus
inference: By this alone, complete union is accomplished for the family-born one
uncertainties: svakulyā+abjāya may refer to a specific deity or lineage member
plain_english: By this alone, an exceedingly close union has been accomplished for the one born of its own family lotus.
